title: Plan safe on P50, violates on P90
description: PV just above the violation threshold on a clear day. At 11:00 the median (P50) forecast predicts no problem, the 90th-percentile (P90) forecast predicts overloads. A plan made on P50 fails on actuals; robust planning should use the upper quantile (and even P90 is exceeded at some steps — coverage is ~78%).
parameter_rationale: pv_multiplier 43: P50 forecast peak (~0.91 pu) x 43 stays below the violation point (~41 pu-multiplier units), P90 peak (~0.985 pu) x 43 exceeds it — between first_violation_mult (42) and 45
